notes.title: Version 1.0.3 Brings VR Improvements
notes.content:
Version 1.0.3 of PolyCube is live, and this version is (almost) all about enhancements for VR users.

VR Improvements

 Massive performance improvements for all VR headsets
 Game now automatically pauses when you enter the Oculus Dash or Steam VR system menus, or remove the headset
 Background music pauses when you enter the Oculus Dash or Steam VR system menus, or remove the headset
 Fixed Oculus Touch controllers mixing up input if an Xbox gamepad is also turned on and connected to the PC


Graphical Improvements

 Fixed Trilinear Filtering and Anisotropic Filtering being disabled. Whoops.


Where is Version 1.0.2?
There is no 1.0.2. I skipped it because there were just so many improvements. (Actually I had a 1.0.2 but it never got released before I moved on to 1.0.3, so you're getting two updates for the price of one!)

notes.title: Ringing in the New Year with Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
Version 1.0.1 of PolyCube is out now, and it brings several important fixes!

Added Finnish Language Support
You can now play PolyCube in 9 different languages!

Improved Analog Stick Support
Those of you using the analog stick on your controllers instead of the d+pad should find PolyCube movement to be much responsive and less floaty.

Fixed Warning Lights/Music
If the blocks got too high, the warning lights would change color and the "panic" music would start playing, but in some situations things wouldn't go back to normal immediately after clearing a few lines. This has been fixed now.

Fixed Line Clearing Dissolve Effect
The particle effect that plays whenever you clear lines now plays faster. This mainly helps VR players.

Misc. Fixes
A few other smaller things have been improved as well.

notes.title: PolyCube has left Early Access!
notes.content:
Very happy to announce that PolyCube has left Early Access on Steam, and with it, the version 1.0 of the game has been published!

There were a ton of changes since the last Early Access version, so here are few highlights:

Added Multiple Language Support
PolyCube is now playable in these languages:

 English
 Simplified Chinese
 Spanish
 French
 German
 Japanese
 Russian
 Polish


And a few more are on their way!

Improved Controller Input
Controller input has been re-written to be even better, especially for VR controllers.

Other Improvements

 Light up the level in yellow/red when blocks are getting high or the game is over
 Improved lighting
 Additional sound effects
 Updated font rendering
 More adjustments to in-game tutorial
 Added Game Credits screen
 Fixes to Leaderboards screens
 Improved skybox
 Added Desktop Camera to VR for better screen recordings
 And more...

notes.title: Improved Tutorial System, Better Controller Support, and More
notes.content:
Version 0.90 of PolyCube is out with a lot of small things, but the biggest improvement is the all new tutorial system, which does a much better job of teaching new players how to play the game!

New & Improved Tutorial
The old tutorial system was scrapped and a better one was built in its place. Now the tutorial does a little more hand holding and actually teaches you how to play the game. Actions are now broken into different sections as well to make learning how to play easier.

    Completely re-wrote Tutorial system to be less bad
    Added better controller button images for Xbox, DualShock, Switch, Steam Controller, Rift, Vive, WMR, and Generic controllers
    Added "How to Play" button to main menu, to re-launch tutorial at any time


Better Controller Support
PolyCube's top-notch controller support is even better!

    Improved Steam Controller support
    Improved Windows Mixed Reality controller support
    Improved generic gamepad support
    Changed default keyboard binding for Rotate Grid from tab/shift to F/G (Existing players may need to manually change their keyboard settings)


Other Changes

    Fixed sometimes moving a PolyCube twice on one joystick press (too sensitive)
    Removed Early Access survey
    Fixed several misc. bugs
    Lots of behind the scenes fixes


With the build version climbing its way towards 1.0, we hope to finish the game and leave Early Access soon!

notes.title: Steam Controller + Windows Mixed Reality Improvements
notes.content:
Version 0.83 of PolyCube is out today, bringing two big improvements:

Improved Steam Controller Support

    Fixed some actions being mapped to wrong buttons
    Fixed problem with Peeking and right trackpad
    Added rumble (vibration) for Steam Controller
    Added Steam Controller button layout to Main Menu > Options > Controller screen


Improved Windows Mixed Reality Support
Big changes to the WMR controllers! Before, they acted like Vive controllres and only the trackpad was used. Now, both the analog sticks and trackpad are in full use. The analog sticks move your PolyCube while the trackpad will rotate it. Use the triggers to drop a block and grips to rotate the grid.

    Improved Windows Mixed Reality button mapping
    Fixed Windows Mixed Reality rumble (vibration)
    Added Windows Mixed Reality button layout to Main Menu > Options > Controller screen

I'd like to take a minute to thank Microsoft for their very generous Windows Mixed Reality development kit they sent me. I wouldn't have been able to add proper WMR support to PolyCube without it!

Known Issue
While these controllers have been added to the Main Menu, they have not been added to the in-game tutorial yet. I am in the process of completely re-working the tutorial to be less horrible, and as such I didn't want to waste time on something that will be thrown away very soon.

notes.title: Leaderboards Added
notes.content:
Version 0.8 of PolyCube has been released, and the big feature this time is Steam Leaderboards!

Steam Leaderboards
After you complete a full game of PolyCube, your score will automatically be posted to the Steam Leaderboards so you can compare your skills against your friends, or the world!


    Separate Leaderboards for each game mode, so you can be the master of Easy 8x8 if you want
    Filter Leaderboards Globally or Friends Only
    VR players share the same Leaderboards with non-VR players
    View all Leaderboards from the Main Menu


Other Changes

    Fixed dropped inputs at high levels (8+) when blocks were dropping faster
    Fixed camera being too close in 8x8 Custom Game grid in non-VR mode
    Misc. bug fixes

notes.title: Version 0.7 Adds Custom Game Mode
notes.content:
Version 0.7 of PolyCube has been released, and the headlining feature is the new Custom Game mode.

Custom Grid Size
You can make the game area larger or smaller. Smaller grids don't make you keep track of as many things at once, but are also more unforgiving of mistakes.

A custom grid can be any of these sizes:

    4 x 4
    5 x 5 (Standard)
    6 x 6
    7 x 7
    8 x 8


Custom PolyCube Set
In addition to resizing the grid, you can also swap out the puzzle pieces themselves to make the game easier or more challenging. The Easy set removes some of the more challenging pieces from the standard set. The Hard set adds a few new PolyCube types not seen in the standard game!

The following PolyCube Sets are available:

    Easy
    Standard
    Hard


More are planned for later!

NOTE: Whenever Leaderboards are added to the game, there will be a separate Leaderboard for each possible Custom Game combination. So you will be able to top the charts for 8 x 8 Hard Set; so start practicing now!

notes.title: Version 0.6 is here
notes.content:
It's been a little while since the last stable build of PolyCube, because I've been working on a lot of things behind the scenes. But the newest build is finally ready! And here's what is in it:


    PolyCube movement & rotation is now fully animated! This makes the game easier to play and looks pretty
    Fixed Shadow cube could become out of sync w/ dropping PolyCube
    Moved scoreboard to be easier to see in VR mode
    Cleaned up input delays and what happens when you push 2 buttons at once
    Added screen shake when clearing lines in non-VR mode
    Leftover blocks drop faster after clearing lines
    Fixed weird bug where leftover blocks can move while dropping
    Lots of other small bug fixes

notes.title: Version 0.5.3 has big Vive Wand fixes
notes.content:
The latest build of PolyCube has the following fixes, most of them specifically to address problems with the Vive Wands for HTC Vive users:

    Fixed offset placement on preview pieces
    Increased panic music threshold to 70%
    Fixed panic music not being reset immediately after clearing lines
    Updated Vive control scheme; see note below
    Fixed Vive pause menu button not working
    Updated Vive controller layout diagram in Options > Controllers


Vive Wand Button Changes
Based on player feedback, we've changed the button layout for VR players using the Vive Wands and Windows Mixed Reality controllers. See the new layout in the Options > Controller menu.

    Actions now only take place once per touchpad press, so you don't accidentally move or rotate too far
    Move PolyCube Down has moved to down on the right touchpad
    Drop PolyCube has moved to the trigger button
    Rotate Grid left/right has moved to the grip buttons
    Pause Menu button now works


NOTE: Players with Oculus Rift Touch controllers or any regular gamepads (Xbox, PS4, Switch, etc) are not affected by this change.

notes.title: New Version 0.5.1 is Out!
notes.content:
Thanks for hanging in there while I got those Vive wand issues sorted out. There's a new version of the game with fixes for that and a few other things:


    Fixed problems with Vive wands and Windows Mixed Reality controllers. They should no longer be super sensitive and you now should push down on the trackpad to do things.
    Moved "Move Down" from Vive trackpad to grip button
    Fixed SteamVR erroneously reporting that Vive controllers were not supported
    Fixed menu UI not working if you used a mouse in VR
    Added Oculus Touch controller layout to Settings > Controller menu
    Added Vive wand layout to Settings > Controller menu
    Other small tweaks and fixes

notes.title: Known Issues
notes.content:
PolyCube is launching today, and we are so excited! Unfortunately, there are a few issues that have cropped up that may cause some trouble for VR users.

    Vive Wands and Windows Mixed Reality controllers are too sensitive and basically unusable. Please use an Xbox, PlayStation 4, or other controller in the meantime.

    Clicking the mouse while in VR mode can cause the in-game menus to no longer work. Please do not use the mouse while in VR mode for now.

We are working to fix these issues as soon as possible and will push out a new patch when we can. We are very sorry for the inconvenience and rough launch.
